text.text:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@northwind.com>
Subject: Notes from Thursday's planning meeting

Hi all,

Thanks for joining on Thursday. Action items:
- Marco: draft the Q4 hiring plan by the 14th
- Lena: book the room for the offsite

The slides are in the team folder. Shout if I missed anything.

Priya

text.label: Legitimate: a colleague asks for a review
text.text:
From: Lena Weber <lena.weber@northwind.com>
Subject: Could you look at my pull request?

Hi Jo,

I've opened the PR for the new export screen. It's not urgent, but it would be great to have your review before Friday's release.
I left a couple of questions in the comments on the date formatting.

Thanks!
Lena

We tried to deliver your parcel today but a customs fee of €1.99 is due.
Pay within 24 hours or it will be returned to the sender: http://dhl-parcel-release.info/pay
